conditions: Production field_lab::fixture and Brain; temporary categorical lateral odor cue_currents adapter and Chamber positive turn gain8 and distance coefficient .012. Brains warm60 unstimulated ticks at stationary initial pose(-2,0), heading0; then300 moving chamber ticks. Fields settle100 ticks before observation. Sources at(-2,-1) and(-2,+1). All source scenes use background brightness .2. No-current controls clear external current each step. Only odor scenarios are run; uniform controls equal no-current controls. Baseline fields omit source: wind0 and source fields cannot affect the body except through disabled neural injection. Bilateral ablation begins after warmup, includes original groups even where stimulus excludes readouts. All comparisons paired by seed.
experimentalMapping: Odor only categorical lateral detection: when max(L,R)>=0.05 and abs(L-R)>0.05*(L+R), inject fixed1 into greater-side pathway and0 into other side; otherwise both0. Only local sensory magnitudes are consulted. Production side identity/readout exclusion are unchanged; body decoder uses positive turn gain8 and distance coefficient .012 instead of .12.
metrics: turn/flightTurn are mean motor outputs. headingTowardSource is source-side signed unwrapped net heading change; positive means yaw toward the initial source side. distanceReduction is initial distance1 minus final source distance. finalAlignmentTowardSource is final heading dot normalized vector to source, positive means facing toward it. Difference metrics subtract the matched control. leftMinusRight uses sourceZ=-1 minus sourceZ=+1; its spatial metrics are each oriented toward their own source.
uncertainty: Student t(9)95% intervals across paired seed means, descriptive without multiplicity correction. Free movement changes subsequent sensory histories; this is a finite closed-loop fixture, not proof of biological preference or asymptotic target seeking.
reproduction: In an isolated checkout with sourceHashes core versions, replace files with experimentalSourceSnapshots and run cargo run -p sim --release --example field_probe -- GRAPH_DIRECTORY OUTPUT_JSON. Original files were restored afterward.
